screens: Agent builder (basics, persona, job and facts, objections and hand-off, tools, voice stack, versions)
Voice stack picker (no default, graded figures)
Docked test panel (practice callers, browser call)
Contacts (people, audiences, import wizard with column mapping and per-row verdicts)
Campaign create (category first, window, pace, cap, estimate)
Campaign page (launch checklist, live meters, funnel, window change)
Call page (two-lane waveform with pins, synced transcript in 3 views, quotes, outcome, explain, compliance trace, cost)
Settings (team, API keys, brand, knowledge, billing, compliance, privacy, operator, activity)
Operator dock on every page (SSE client, plan/approval/receipt cards, hold-to-confirm)
works: esbuild build to dist/ with hashed JS/CSS and per-page chunks; served by server/app.ts as is

Real Operator module end to end in dev: POST /v1/operator/threads then .../messages, SSE frames parsed (message, delta, step, card, notice, error, done); plan, approval and receipt cards rendered; approval holds 1.2 s (or two presses) then POST /v1/actions/:id/decide
Today renders the real brief.today shape (needsTap, liveCampaigns, spendToday, wallet, issues, changed) and opens approvals from it
Sign up, sign in, sign out against the kernel; 401 anywhere returns to sign-in
Disabled primary actions always carry a reason (enforced by the Btn type); unsaved markers on drafts; no dropdown or menu writes (test)
Voice stack picker lists all 8 stacks from shared/stacks.ts with no default, grade chips and sources; price comes from money.estimate or shows not measured
Colour tokens pass 5:1 in light and dark (tests/web.test.ts); colour literals only in tokens.css
Screenshots of every screen at 390x844 and 1440x900 in web/shots/, with no horizontal scroll and no console errors in the dev run
untested: Everything above was exercised only against stand-in tools (web/dev/mock-module.ts) and a scripted fake model; none of it has met the real agents, campaigns, calls, contacts, numbers, money or workspace modules
Browser call: the button calls test.browser_call and shows the reason when it is unavailable; no audio, microphone or WebRTC path exists to test
Audio playback on the call page: the player is written for an audioUrl but no call had audio; the waveform is drawn from server peaks
Hindi, Anek and Fraunces fonts: the app names them first and falls back to Inter/Noto/FreeSans; no font files are shipped, so the type specimen gate has not run
Dark theme was checked by contrast numbers, not by eye on every screen
Real-device phone testing: layouts were checked in headless Chromium at 390x844, not on a mid-range Android
Screen reader and keyboard walkthroughs: focus rings, roles and labels are in place; no assistive-technology run was made
Speech input (Web Speech API, hi-IN) was not exercised
Hold-to-confirm was checked by script clicks, not on a touch device
needs_from_others: workspace-tool-registry.json is not in the repo: the UI invented tool ids and result shapes for agent.*, contact.*, audience.*, campaign.*, call.*, insight.*, learning.*, experiment.*, number.*, member.*, apikey.*, brand.*, knowledge.*, wallet.*, billing.summary, compliance.get, privacy.get, dpdp.request.list, activity.list, version.publish, test.simulate, test.browser_call. Owners of those modules should return the shapes in web/src/types.ts or tell web the real ones

kernel: A3 verbs (campaign.pause, campaign.stop and the other closed-list verbs) run immediately only for agent/system actors, so a signed-in person pressing Pause gets an approval request. A person should be able to run a risk-lowering verb at once; the UI handles either outcome

kernel/operator: the router buffers the SSE body, so replies arrive in one piece. The client already parses incrementally and types the text out; real streaming needs a streaming response from http.ts
kernel: server/modules/index.ts does not list the operator or memory modules yet; web/dev/serve.ts imports them directly

money: money.estimate must return perMinuteInrMilli (null when unmeasured) and a basis string; the picker shows both. wallet.get is expected to return { balanceMilli, spentTodayMilli, capTodayMilli, runwayDays }

voice: sample audio clips per stack (the picker says 'No sample recorded yet'); a browser-call endpoint for test.browser_call; per-call audio URL and server-computed waveform peaks (about 20 KB per 3 minutes)
calls: transcript in native script, romanised and English per turn with t0/t1 and reply gap; moments and quotes; compliance trace per call
memory: contact.memory.get shape is richer than the UI's contact.get memory block; the contact page should switch to it when contacts land
design: Anek and Fraunces woff2 files (self-hosted, Latin and Devanagari subsets, under 100 KB) for the type specimen gate
operator: operator.brain.set stores a choice but the LLM door ignores it (their note); settings shows it as chosen

dev.run: eval $(sh product/scripts/pg-test.sh vp_mod_web); node product/web/build.mjs; node --import tsx product/web/dev/serve.ts
dev.note: mock-module.ts is dev-only and is never imported by server/main.ts
